rules: An availability question adds nothing. Remember the dish it names. Examples: do you have, got any, is there, ¿tienen, ¿hay.

A bare quantity after exactly one discussed dish orders that dish at the spoken number. Give me two, I'll take two, dame dos, and ponme dos are the same kind of turn. Two discussed dishes, or no discussed dish: ask. Do not guess.

Replacement swaps the one current choice and does not also keep it. mejor dame, mejor quiero, en vez de eso, instead, rather, and better give me are replacements. Two current choices: ask which one. A number that was not spoken is one, never a copy of the old line's quantity.
Additive and, y, también, and also adds the named dish and removes nothing.
Do not invent a required choice, a size, or a substitute for a sold-out or unknown item. Ask, or leave the choice open. These rules do not override catalog availability or required options.
